status: frozen phase-one wire contract; source implementation and runtime qualification pending
encoding: delegation-v1 strict canonical UTF8 JSON, ASCII sorted keys, safe integers, preserve objects/arrays; no duplicates/floats/invalid Unicode
normalization: site_url is exact normalized HTTPS MainWP URL without trailing slash, credentials, query or fragment; child-derived affected_paths remain exact origin-relative URLs, no foreign origin, secrets or unbounded crawl

qa.required: Trusted protected runner independently binds exact plan, profile/runtime context, before/candidate snapshots, affected render paths, migration and report. Required applicable API/browser/a11y/performance/render-ownership checks may not be skipped. Existing file/source-review receipts never qualify content.

approval: Same-person approval allowed under current single-person policy; execute requires original preparer, active staff, exact digest and fresh independently verified QA/backup
lock: Existing private MRN_MainWP_Site_Lock with mrn_code_site_lock_<id>; preserve uncertainty/consumed operations; no automatic mutation retry or public force-unlock
cas: Child-side supported transactional engine, authoritative row locking/re-read plus fixed typed WordPress update. Reject unqualified engines/hooks/records. Verify after exact semantic snapshot. Direct native REST lacks CAS and is not a fallback.
migration: Immutable encrypted authenticated central bundle, public opaque ref+hash, exact live ID plus stable post_type/post_path selector. Already-applied candidate is a verified no-op. Another-environment replay requires fresh resolution, QA, approval, backup and new operation. No per-site repository/staff token/caller PHP.
error_transport: Standard WordPress WP_Error before dispatch; after attempted mutation report status.state=failed or uncertain. Never imply failed means safe retry. Uncertain retains lock and receipt consumption.
roadmap: Qualified ACF scalar field/reference CAS; no raw post_custom/repeaters/builders
Qualified attachment title/caption/alt metadata; file import/replacement separately qualified
activation: Content policy is owner-provisioned and default disabled. get-content-policy reports absent/unqualified runtime profiles honestly. No production enrollment/access/credential changes performed by this contract.

plan_digest.exclusions: No volatile timestamps, signatures, backup receipts, caller identity or raw snapshots in descriptor; their hashes/immutable stored authorization bind them separately.

rollback_hash_semantics: Every migration bundle rollback_snapshot_sha256 equals that operation before_sha256. For forward A->B it is A; for qualified rollback B->A it is B. rollback_operation_id is empty for forward, and the original completed forward UUID for rollback. Recursive rollback is not initially qualified.
